gloss: to be respectful; to humbly do

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {謹|つつし}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to respectfully do; to humbly offer
definitions.explanation: To perform an action with deep respect and humility. Used in very formal contexts such as official announcements, New Year's greetings, and formal letters. Almost always appears in the form 謹んで (respectfully).

examples.japanese: {謹|つつし}んでお⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
{謹|つつし}んで⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{慶|よろこ}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I respectfully offer my New Year's congratulations.

examples.japanese: {謹|つつし}んで⟦お{悔|く}やみ→お悔やみ：15866_okuyami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。

notes:
Almost always used in the て-form {謹|つつし}んで, "respectfully, humbly," placed before a humble verb in formal speech and writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {謹|つつし}んでお⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to humbly accept
- {謹|つつし}んで⟦お{悔|く}やみ→お悔やみ：15866_okuyami⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧: please accept my deepest condolences
- {謹|つつし}んで⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{慶|よろこ}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧: a formal New Year greeting

WATCH OUT:
⟦{慎|つつし}む→慎む：09158_tsutsushimu⟧ (to be careful, to refrain) has the same reading but a different meaning: self-restraint, not reverence. The kanji {謹|きん} also appears in ⟦{謹賀新年|きんがしんねん}→謹賀新年：17279_kingashinnen⟧, the New Year's card greeting.
